solution:
The dual interchanges \(\wedge\) with \(\vee\) and the constant \(t\) (tautology) with \(c\) (contradiction); \(\sim\) is unchanged.

Given: \(\sim p \vee (q \wedge r) \wedge t\).

**Dual: \(\sim p \wedge [(q \vee r) \vee c]\).**
note: the given pattern groups as ~p v [(q ^ r) ^ t], so its dual is ~p ^ [(q v r) v c]; the printed ~p ^ (q v r) v c groups as (~p ^ (q v r)) v c. Brackets added.
